title: KP composable animation runtime v0 loop
summary: Durable execution contract for the approved KP direction: predictable, inspectable, composable animations as typed assets driven by one clock and reusable across math, graphs, programming, generated problems, and flashcards.

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Decision naming AnimationAsset as the primary composable KP artifact.
Active workflow frontier for dashboard-backed semantic animation system work.

allowedWork: Work on AnimationAsset runtime sampling, diagnostics, dashboard previews, external deterministic ports, programming trace imports, flashcard projections, and composition laws.
Keep semantic objects, transformations, render targets, layouts, and timelines as typed data that can be inspected and sampled.
Commit after each verified slice and record Theseus evidence.
disallowedWork: Do not rewrite the full renderer or equation animation DOM pipeline in this loop.
Do not add GIF/video encoders or large live external integrations in this loop.
Do not stage unrelated worktree changes.
goal: Advance KP from typed AnimationAsset definitions to a renderer-neutral runtime that samples, composes, imports deterministic external data, and projects animation assets into dashboard previews, programming traces, and flashcards.
stopConditions: Stop if a slice requires broad renderer replacement instead of an incremental typed runtime adapter.
Stop if verification fails and the fix is not local to the active slice.
Stop if external port work requires networked live integrations rather than deterministic fixtures.
